title: Worker keys: hashed storage, scopes, 14-day expiry, a command-line issuer
done_when: make suite BACKEND=http passes T01, T02 and T16 against a local server
constraints: Read AGENTS.md first; the spec wins over the code
Never edit conformance-draft/ tests or SPEC.md in this task, and never weaken a test
Writes are POST only; a GET on a write path answers 405 and changes nothing
No key, token or credential in any response, page, log or commit
Run make check before committing; one task per branch; do not push
Store only SHA-256 of keys; print a new key once, at issue time
No key may hold the public effect class
notes: Done Oct 26, 2026 by claude-code (taken over from muse-code so agents could connect the same day); verified by tests/test_service.py and scripts/suite_http_local.py.
